title: Experimental Discipline: Visual Guide
outline: 1. From Metric To Decision | the bridge from IR 104's golden set and nDCG@10 0.55 to 0.58 into four instruments, with evidence toggles lighting up which of five shipping questions become answerable | each instrument answers its own question and is silent on the others, so an offline number alone is a reading and not a decision

2. Where Each Lies | two sliders for offline delta nDCG@10 and online delta task success, plotting the reading in a quadrant with the suspects for each corner | disagreement is diagnostic - offline up online down points at label mismatch, latency, presentation or gaming, while offline down online up points at incomplete judgments or a misleading online proxy

3. Same Mean, Different Risk | system A spread from [0.6,0.6,0.4,0.4] out to [0.9,0.9,0.1,0.1] against a fixed system B, with an acceptability threshold and a paired-delta view computing Var(B-A) = Var(A) + Var(B) - 2Cov(A,B) live | a mean of 0.500 hides two completely different products, and pairing cancels shared query difficulty - paired sd 0.30 against unpaired 0.412 at full spread

4. Bootstrap And Permutation | a live paired bootstrap and permutation test over 25 to 1600 queries with a minimum-practically-important-effect slider, plus a 100-configuration multiplicity grid | the interval narrows as 1/sqrt(n) in queries not resamples, a p-value is evidence against a null and not importance, and 100 configurations under a true null produce about five spurious wins

5. Slice The Regression | seven query classes summing to the +0.015 headline, with a minimum-class-size slider setting confirmatory versus lead, and per-class root cause and counterfactual stage ladder | the mean hides a 0.12 loss on 40 exact error-code queries caused by semantic candidates consuming the reranking pool, and a 3-query class with a 0.20 gain can never be confirmatory
